title: ASTEROID BLAST
oneLiner: Pilot your tiny ship through a storm of tumbling space rocks and blast them before they crush you.
mechanics: Move the ship around the screen with the d-pad.
Press A to fire shots at drifting asteroids.
Large asteroids split into smaller, faster chunks when hit.
Score points for every asteroid destroyed; the swarm speeds up over time.

controls.b: Hypershift a short distance, with a cooldown

lose: The ship loses all three lives after colliding with an asteroid.
scoring: Earn more points for destroying smaller asteroid chunks and clearing waves.
